title: Cloud Lambdas: sort, crop, box filter, id generator
hints: sortByDistance: capture `origin` in the comparator and compare SQUARED distances. Which sort keeps ties in their original order?
removeOutOfRange: `cloud.erase(std::remove_if(..., lambda), cloud.end())`; remember the old size to compute the count.
makeBoxFilter must capture `lo` and `hi` BY VALUE, because the returned lambda outlives the function's parameters.
